name: d1_pow2
description: Stockham autosort DIF: blocked split-complex radix-8 engine at L>=128 (zero-shuffle middle stages, conversion fused into the stride-1 stage), transpose-first stride-1 stage with block-lane full-width twiddle SCMULs where the working set is cache-resident (L<=2048, batch*32L<=2MB; r8), compact (c,s)-pair twiddle tables at the fill-bound sizes, first-stage pair fused IN REGISTERS when the second stage is radix-4 (128/1024/4096; two-pass 128, d1_twiddle's register re-derivation of my r4 tile fusion taken back) or through an L1 tile at 16384, middle radix-8 pair fused into a radix-64 tile pass at 4096/16384, in-register AoS codelets at L=32/64, NT final stores when in+out exceed 16 MB; chains: across-batch SoA groups of 8 (L<=2048, from d1_batchlane) or per-transform blocking, with d1_prime's latency-shaped map (early-seeded rcp, Goldschmidt sqrt, additive floor) fused into the final stage in split form
